description: Upload an attachment to a SWSD incident, problem, change, release, solution, hardware asset, other asset, or configuration item. Use content_base64 for hosted/HTTP clients; file_path is allowed only on stdio. WRITE — honors SWSD_WRITE_MODE.

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded file contents. Use this for HTTP transport.

file_name.description: File name to show in SWSD (maximum 255 characters).

file_path.description: Local filesystem path. Allowed only when SWSD_TRANSPORT=stdio.

name: swsd_upload_attachment
